name: sandbox-create-balance-empty
about: A personal account whose balance is used up with auto top-up off: 402 balance_empty, with where to turn it on or buy credit in fix (top_up_failed when the last auto top-up failed on the card). Running sandboxes keep running; files and exports still work.

response.error: your balance is used up and auto top-up is off; new sandboxes are refused (running ones keep running, and their files and exports are not affected)
response.fix: turn auto top-up on or buy credit at https://node.example:48000/app/#/billing
